Round 5's text about the residual quotes three things the measurements contradict.

(a) The filler band. The text says 'and only with fillers 0.256–0.264 across (5 to 42 g; 0.242–0.254 and 0.266–0.280 nothing)' (§4.3), 'with fillers 0.256–0.264 across only' (§17.2) and 'only with fillers 0.256–0.264' (E-S2.14). I swept fillers 0.240–0.282 every 0.001 against Balls 0.10–0.28 every 0.01 (work/probe7b.luau, out/probe7b_live.txt):
- 0.256–0.265 move, 7 of 19 Ball sizes each.
- 0.240–0.255 and 0.266–0.282 move nothing.
- f7ac37d is identical over 0.250–0.270 (out/probe7b_base.txt).
E-S2.14 quotes 'a filler 0.265 with a Ball 0.25, −5.3 g' in the same parenthesis as its 'only'. probe7's 0.002 grid skipped 0.265.

(b) Which box. §17.2 says 'Reviewer V1's Dust specks buried in that box's wall or in F2's guard, +1.2e-3 and +2.6e-3 kg', and E-S2.14 says 'Reviewer V1's specks in that box'. 'That box' is V2's box: walls 0.04, one filler 0.258. V1's hsteer2 used a different box, boxedF2 (walls 0.02, two overlapping Guard fillers 0.258 × 0.258 × 0.19). In V2's box, a legal Dust Ball 0.02 buried in wall 16 on the filler's poke moves the mass +1.486e-6 kg. That equals ρ times what it owns, so nothing moves through the measuring (fillers 0.25, 0.258, 0.27; work/probe6s.luau, out/probe6s.txt).

(c) The buried Dust Balls. The text says 'a Dust Ball buried in the largest kept part of every 5th (1,011 designs) move nothing' (§4.3), 'none of … 1,011 buried Dust Balls moves anything' (§17.2) and '… moves anything' (E-S2.14). On 8 of the 1,011 the mass does move (work/sweepspeck2.luau, out/ss2_live_pl5.txt):
- The 8 are 6 wrapRings|C09 designs and 2 cages, e.g. #8832 wrapRings|C09|n3 extra0.02 gap0.0010.
- The Ball sits wholly inside a kept Block, yet owns 8.094e-6 through its own sampled overlap, so the mass moves +6.37e-5 kg.
- No other part's owned volume moves. That is what my round-4 sweep measured, and M3-notes words it that way ('moves no part away from it').

summary:
The code part of round 5 holds, but I can't pass it: two passages of round-5 text are false against the measurements. Both are fixed in tried copies.

**Code (holds):**
- V1's fix A is the only code change. Every output equals round 4 byte for byte on all 37,725 designs, on their mirror images and under id shuffles.
- Not one of 24,221 Ctrl+D copies moves anything on round 5; round 4 moved 11 copies on 4 designs.
- §5.5's table, the goldens and the parity digest are unchanged.
- The new pins catch all 13 mutants I built myself, each on the assertion aimed at it.
- Verify from a fresh clean copy is green (776 tests).
- Cost is noise against round 4 (×0.994 and ×1.003).
- On a quiet machine `--quick` reads 27.8–28.4 s against round 4's 29.5–31.5 s, under the 29 s target. T-PERF-01 run alone passes 5 of 5 (57.3–59.2 ms).

**Major 1, the residual's figures (§4.3, §17.2, E-S2.14):**
- 'Only fillers 0.256–0.264' is wrong: 0.265 moves the mass too, by −5.27 g, and E-S2.14 itself quotes a 0.265 case.
- V1's specks are placed in the wrong box. In the box the text names, a wall speck moves the mass only by what it owns.
- 'A buried Dust Ball moves nothing' is wrong on 8 of 1,011 designs: the mass moves +6.4e-5 kg, by the Ball's own share.

**Major 2, M3's Ctrl+D figure (§4.3, §17.2, plain words):** the text says M3 moved the mass by at most 0.89 g on 7 designs. Over the sample the sentence names, M3 moves it on 19 designs, by up to 6.9 g; the 0.89 g covers only half the sample.

**Minors:**
- V1's specks are 0.015 across, under MIN_DIM, which the editor refuses; at 0.02 the quoted figures still hold.
- Timings fail only when other agents load the machine.
